new_blocker_discovered.statement: The XODR's own coordinate frame does not inverse-project to the stated authoritative Ingolstadt location under any standard projection tested. The authoritative CRS parameters are therefore NOT derivable from the available artifacts, so a correct fail-closed parser cannot yet be given correct source-derived values.
new_blocker_discovered.method: pyproj 3.7.2. Projected the stated authoritative point (lat=48.766, lon=11.425) forward into candidate CRSs and compared against the XODR <offset> (E=832671.676, N=5458671.104).
observations: No candidate reproduces the offset. The closest by easting, UTM32N, is still 154 km off in easting and 54 km off in northing.

The XODR northing (5458671.104) is ~55 km north of the northing that lat=48.766 implies in EPSG:31468 (5403322.4). German Gauss-Kruger northing advances ~111 km per degree, so the frame's northing corresponds to approximately lat 49.26, not 48.766.
Inverse-transforming the offset through tmerc/UTM variants yields lon approximately 49.19E, which is not 11.425E.
The 42/2 fallback is geospatially meaningless for this map: lat 42.0/lon 2.0 is southern France (Gironde), roughly 800 km from Ingolstadt.
new_blocker_discovered.implication: Either the stated authoritative lat/lon is not established, or the map's origin was generated from a wrong or unknown CRS. This must be resolved from the upstream OSM/projection configuration before GeoReferenceParser can be given correct source-derived +lat_0/+lon_0. Guessing constants is explicitly forbidden and was not done.

critical_design_constraint_for_the_fix.finding: Emitting a CORRECT projection string is NOT sufficient to stop the 42/2 fallback.
critical_design_constraint_for_the_fix.reason: GeoReferenceParser recognises only +lat_0 and +lon_0. Neither the UTM string (+proj=utm +zone=N ...) nor the DHDN Gauss-Kruger string (+proj=tmerc +lat_0=0 +lon_0=... +ellps=bessel +datum=potsdam ...) is guaranteed to be what CARLA reads: the DHDN form does carry +lat_0/+lon_0 but with +lat_0=0 (the equator), not the map's true latitude. Feeding +lat_0=0 to CARLA would place the map at the equator - a different and equally wrong silent failure.
required_fix_shape: 1. OSM2ODR must serialize a geoReference that explicitly carries the map's true +lat_0 and +lon_0 (not merely +lon_0 of a Gauss-Kruger zone with +lat_0=0).
2. GeoReferenceParser must fail closed: reject any geoReference lacking +lat_0 or +lon_0, and reject malformed numerics, instead of defaulting to 42/2.
3. The +lat_0/+lon_0 values must come from source-derived CRS parameters recorded at generation time, not from constants.
critical_design_constraint_for_the_fix.preferred_hierarchy_followed: Layer 1 (emit complete authoritative definition) is the correct primary fix; layer 2 (parser rejects incomplete) is the required defence in depth; layer 3 (remove the 42/2 production fallback) is mandatory.
critical_design_constraint_for_the_fix.hardcoding_ingolstadt_constants: NOT DONE, and blocked: source parameters are unavailable (see new_blocker_discovered).

required_tests_not_yet_written.note: Deliberately not written yet. Fail-closed behaviour cannot be validated against correct expected values until the authoritative CRS is resolved, and writing tests that encode guessed constants would manufacture false assurance.
